acceptedFindings.claim: Logic is better represented as a cross-domain foundational/methodological axis than as an ordinary child of mathematics.
Computation and information require distinct but overlapping identities; neither should be collapsed into software engineering or communications.
Astronomy deserves first-class major-domain representation, while cosmology is currently better modeled as a physics↔astronomy major bridge/subspace.
Earth science/geoscience deserves first-class major-domain representation; atmosphere, ocean and geology are major subspaces, while climate is a cross-system bridge.
Cognitive science is an interdisciplinary bridge-domain discipline, not a subclass of psychology; neuroscience and linguistics also require first-class identities with multi-domain placement.
Measurement/metrology is a cross-domain methodological/epistemic axis and must not be forced under a single object-domain.
